_doc: The lead's standing rulings for release smokes. Each excuses at most `max` FAIL lines matching `regex` in the run or case `target` (and in its catalog subset_of cases), and lowers that run's PASS want by the lines it excuses (smokes.py judge). smokes.py plan and run add every entry without `lifted` by themselves, in every release, until the lead lifts it: set "lifted": "lead <UTC time>: <why>" and keep the entry for the record. Add an entry only from a lead ruling in queue.md and quote its time in `ruled`. Never for a crash, hang or watchdog line. A release-only allowance still goes on the command line (plan --allow).

rulings.regex: ^FAIL agentpane2 chromium: needs you \[(✦ in a full-screen window|notification, from a full-screen window)\]
rulings.why: posted-only known limit: "✦ in a full-screen window" passes with real input (4/4); the notification case has no real-input path (the posted click handler lacks the system activation). Covers the subset runs -ux3 and -needsyou.
